label: sec:cohomological-defect-preamble
html: Where does matter arise? The Frobenius structure of A is globally non-degenerate, but it can fail locally. Matter emerges where a non-degenerate Levi form obstructs the Frobenius pairing. The unit particle is the fundamental cohomological defect, a generator of the local cohomology at the singular point z = 1.
